scope: Captured M32 K6144 N160 WK BF16 controls and stock FP32 outputs; no timing or full-layer acceptance
interpretation: Output dtype may change CANN tiling. A direct BF16 versus FP32-result comparison alone does not isolate Fixpipe rounding.
control_contract: Every full-N160 BF16 arm must match captured production and every split-N32 BF16 arm must match captured native before either FP32 arm runs.

schemas.mm_dtype: aten::mm.dtype(Tensor self, Tensor mat2, ScalarType out_dtype) -> Tensor
